slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
To find the area of a composite figure, split it into rectangles, triangles and trapezoids, or surround it with a rectangle and subtract the pieces outside. The area addition postulate says the parts add up to the whole.

An L-shaped room made of a 10 by 6 rectangle and a 4 by 3 rectangle has area 60 + 12 = 72 square units, as long as the pieces do not overlap.
